meta.promptText: I want to buy a sunscreen that doesn't leave a white cast on Indian skin. Which one is best?

response.text:
If your priority is **no white cast on Indian skin**, my first pick is:

### [Minimalist SPF 50 PA++++ Sunscreen]()
*₹499*

### 🥇 Best overall: Minimalist SPF 50 PA++++
- **No white cast** and designed to disappear into the skin.
- **SPF 50 + PA++++** broad-spectrum protection.
- Lightweight, fragrance-free and non-comedogenic.
- Works across dry, normal, oily and combination skin.
- Around **₹380–₹400 for 50 g** on the brand site. [beminimalist.co](https://beminimalist.co/collections/best-sellers/products/multi-vitamin-spf-50?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### If you have oily skin
### [Re'equil Ultra Matte Dry Touch SPF 50 PA++++]()
*₹310.50*

This is an excellent alternative if you want a **matte, non-greasy finish**. Recent Indian sunscreen comparisons rate it particularly highly for oily/combination skin, with no noticeable white cast. [sskin.care](https://sskin.care/lists/best-sunscreens-india/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### If you want something very lightweight
### [Minimalist Light Fluid SPF 50]()
*₹315*

It's a thinner, fluid formula and is particularly suitable if you dislike the feeling of traditional sunscreen. [sskin.care](https://sskin.care/lists/best-sunscreens-india/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**My verdict:** If you just want me to pick **one**, buy **Minimalist SPF 50 PA++++**. It's the best balance of no white cast, protection, texture and price.

If you tell me whether your skin is **oily, dry, combination, acne-prone, or sensitive**, I can narrow it down to the best one specifically for you.
